suite: T36 Solutions C v3 source static check

hard_failures.evidence: Visible Chinese / Traditional Chinese page text includes `Candao`, `關於 Candao`, and `找到適合的 Candao 解決方案`.
HTML contains multiple external `` tags using generated or hosted restaurant / dashboard imagery.
Visible operational counts include `142`, `38`, `248`, `12`, `3`, and `42`, which are not confirmed metrics for this Solutions page.

Material icon names are visible in HTML text, including `check_circle`, `store`, `two_wheeler`, `admin_panel_settings`, `local_shipping`, `sync_alt`, `motorcycle`, `route`, `hub`, and `arrow_forward`.
Footer still uses `Candao` and includes Traditional Chinese legal links `隱私政策` / `服務條款` that are not part of the confirmed T27/T35 primary footer requirement.
Hero headline is `從營運問題出發，找到適合的 Candao 解決方案`, not the current approved Solutions direction `按餐飲 O2O 營運問題，找到可落地的解決方案`.

conclusion: The existing C v3 Solutions screen is not eligible for formal design-handoff output.
